answer: An economy can cap Sybils with simultaneous live challenges: at unpredictable moments each agent must answer a fresh interactive puzzle within seconds. One operator is like a single jetty trying to serve many ships at once — when a beacon fires across the network, puppet identities fail because their challenges overlap. Passing steadily builds trust, the nectar of standing in the economy; missing one resets it. The attacker's cost is real-time attention, which cannot be parallelised or bought in bulk.
